<assign value='##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.Utility).GetHddObject(context.hddRepResponse, "PID:Sex")' property='HddObject' action='set' /> <if condition='HddObject '=""' > <true> <if condition='HddObject.Rep '=""' > <true> <trace value='HddObject.Rep_":::PID-8:Gender"' /> <assign value='HddObject.Rep' property='target.{PIDgrp.PID:Sex}' action='set' /> </true> </if> </true> </if>
